fields.statement: At 6acb2fe: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/rex-install passes; the script test greps rhiza.lua for rex.action entries titled with app names from readapps (roadmap, session-ls), writeapps (accept) and modelapp (model), each running "tui", "app", <name>. go test ./internal/api -run TestRexInstall -count=2 passes; TestRexInstallRegistersAnActionPerApp registers zz-extra, installs and finds its action, checks for 1+len(launcher.Apps()) rex.action calls, then registers zz-later, reinstalls and finds its action. A scratch build with a fake rex and REX_CONFIG wrote rhiza.lua with 17 rex.action blocks: rhiza_launch plus one for each of the 16 registered apps (7 readapps, 8 writeapps, model). Each block is titled with the app's name and runs {BIN, "tui", "app", <name>} in a layer. A reinstall was byte-identical. In make check, fmt, vet and every go test pass; self-check reports only stale .rhiza/rendered actor and index files from run state, which this leaf's diff does not touch.
